subject: Running lanes: mid-quarter OKR pulse and targeted rescope asks
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Running lanes: mid-quarter OKR pulse and targeted rescope asks

Team,

Quick mid-Q pulse ahead of our QBR prep — the Q4 OKR scoreboard is attached. High level:

- Objective A (Reduce token cost 30%): Yellow — quantization work is on track but we need infra validation for one-week stress runs; without that we'll risk missing the 30% target by EOW-5.
- Objective B (Latency P95 <= 180ms): Red — regression after recent kernel bump; root cause points to batching scheduler and a model variant fallback gap.
- Objective C (Enterprise renewals expansion): Green — ACME pilot is healthy, they asked for committed latency SLO and a shorter procurement window.

Asks (concrete):
1) Infra: reserve a 4x A100 cluster for a 5-day quantization validation window starting 2026-10-25. Owner: infra-oncall, impact: Objective A. Attachment: Q4_midquarter_status_table.xlsx
2) Runtime/ServOps: prioritize a scheduler hotfix and enable a canary rollback path for the kernel bump by 2026-10-22. Owner: runtime team, impact: Objective B.
3) Legal/Finance: quick review of the ACME pilot addendum (procurement wants a 30-day turnaround). Attachment: acme_pilot_term_summary.pdf
4) CS & Solutions: prepare a two-week beta support run for ACME (limit to 5 seats) starting 2026-10-26.

I've marked owners in the attached sheet and added a suggested minimal rescope for two initiatives to keep runway for the critical infra work.

Please reply with ack + any blocking constraints by EOD today. If you want a 20-minute huddle, I'm available 14:00-15:00 PT.

- Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Q4_midquarter_status_table.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme_pilot_term_summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Running lanes: mid-quarter OKR pulse and targeted rescope asks

Sean — thanks for the clear asks and the attachments.

Ack on infra reservation. I can free one of the reserve clusters by shifting a non-critical benchmarking job to next month; I'll confirm by 12:30 PT today.

On Objective B (latency): can the runtime team scope a short-term mitigant (raise per-request timeout + smaller batch size) that we can ship to prod as an emergency band-aid? If so, we should schedule the rollback window immediately after deploy.

I also suggest we hold a 25-minute sync at 14:15 PT to align owners and make sure Legal has everything they need for the ACME addendum.

Marissa

Subject: Re: Running lanes: mid-quarter OKR pulse and targeted rescope asks

Thanks, Sean — good concise ask list.

Decision: approved partial rescope for one lower-impact initiative to free short-term infra credits. Finance will earmark up to $18k of credits for the validation window — legal, please confirm there are no billing/contract blockers.

On the latency regression, I want a one-pager from runtime by tomorrow COB that outlines root cause, short-term mitigants, and confidence of fix. If the mitigant is low-risk we should deploy it and keep rollback ready.

I won't be on the 14:15 sync; assign a deputy and capture decisions in the doc.

Vivek

On 2026-10-18 11:02, Marissa Cole wrote:
> Sean — thanks for the clear asks and the attachments.
From: Claire Zhou <c.zhou@acmeai.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Running lanes: mid-quarter OKR pulse and targeted rescope asks

Sean,

Appreciate the update and the proactive timeline. We're aligned to a 30-day procurement review but two asks from our side before we sign off:

- Confirm commitment to the latency P95 SLO for the pilot (we can accept a conditional SLO if you include an emulated rollback/cutover plan).
- Can you share the minimal support commitment for the 5-seat beta (hours, escalation path)?

We'd like to see the ACME pilot addendum and a brief (1-page) tech note on the expected latency variance during the beta. If you can send both by EOD Monday (2026-10-19), we can move procurement faster.

Thanks,
Claire
